name: Georgia
agency: Georgia Department of Natural Resources, Law Enforcement Division

rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1998 must have passed a DNR-approved boater education course to run any motorized vessel.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1998 o después debe haber aprobado un curso de educación náutica aprobado por el DNR para manejar cualquier embarcación con motor.

minAge.note: Under 12: only boats under 16 ft, non-motorized or 30 hp or less, with a competent adult. 12-15: boats under 16 ft incl. PWC with the course or a competent adult; nothing over 16 ft.

exemptions: Operating on a private lake or pond.
Nonresident with proof of a NASBLA-approved course or equivalency exam from another state.
nonResident: Visitors with proof of a NASBLA-approved course from another state are exempt.

sources.quote: As of July 1, 2014, all persons born on or after January 1, 1998 that operate any motorized vessel on the waters of the state must have completed a boat education course approved by the department prior to such operation.
a non-resident who has in his or her possession proof that he or she has completed a NASBLA approved boater education course or equivalency examination from another state.
May legally operate a vessel under 16 feet in length which is either non-motorized or powered by a motor of 30 horsepower or less only if they are accompanied by a competent adult.
A person is exempt if he or she is: a person licensed by the U.S. Coast Guard as a master of a vessel; a person operating on a private lake or pond;
